dialogues.jp: 朝の光。
dialogues.en:
I sighed, looking at the sleeping beauty as she lay on the
bed.
dialogues.text:
I sighed, looking at the sleeping beauty as she lay on the
bed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「音夢……もうすぐ昼だぞ」
ゆさゆさ、と枕を揺らす。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おい」
ベッドの脇のぬいぐるみを顔にのせる。
dialogues.en:
I took a stuffed animal from her bedside, and put it on her
face.
dialogues.text:
I took a stuffed animal from her bedside, and put it on her
face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うに……っん？　兄さん？」
音夢がむにむにと呟く。

とりあえず、今日は｛・・・・・・／寝たきりの日｝ではないらし
い。
dialogues.en: I guess today isn't the .."sleeping all day" kind of day.
dialogues.text: I guess today isn't the .."sleeping all day" kind of day.

dialogues.jp:
どんな反応でも、その日を音夢と一緒にいられ
ることに安堵してしまう。
dialogues.en:
I'm glad to spend a day with Nemu no matter how she reacts
to me.
dialogues.text:
I'm glad to spend a day with Nemu no matter how she reacts
to me.

dialogues.jp: 「起きたか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「起きたぁ……今何時？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「もうすぐお昼だ。お前の好きなキュウリとハ
　ムのサンドイッチを作ってやったぞ」
dialogues.en:
"It's almost noon. I made you a cucumber and ham sandwich.
Don't you like that?"
dialogues.text:
"It's almost noon. I made you a cucumber and ham sandwich.
Don't you like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、本当？　起きる起きる」

口調とは裏腹に、ベッドの中でむずむずと小さ
な身じろぎがあるだけだ。
dialogues.en:
But she was only moving a little in her bed, opposed to what
she said.
dialogues.text:
But she was only moving a little in her bed, opposed to what
she said.

dialogues.jp: 「そのまま寝るなよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん……すぐ行く」

ほとんど寝息と同じ返事にため息をつきながら、
俺は部屋を出る。
dialogues.en:
I sighed at her reply as it sounded like she was still
asleep, and I walked out of her room.
dialogues.text:
I sighed at her reply as it sounded like she was still
asleep, and I walked out of her room.

dialogues.jp: 異常だ。

こんな朝の何気ない風景が、この世界が根本か
ら変わってしまったことを象徴する。
dialogues.en:
This usual scene in the morning now, it symbolizes how my
world has completely changed.
dialogues.text:
This usual scene in the morning now, it symbolizes how my
world has completely changed.

dialogues.jp: 音夢を俺が起こしているなんてな。

結局、音夢が居間に下りてきたのは、それから
２時間後だった。
dialogues.en: Nemu came downstairs two hours after that.
dialogues.text: Nemu came downstairs two hours after that.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「へ……くしゅん！」
ソファーに座っていた音夢がくしゃみをする。
dialogues.en: Nemu sneezed as she sat on the sofa.
dialogues.text: Nemu sneezed as she sat on the sofa.

dialogues.jp: 「治らないな」

デザートにとリンゴを皿に盛って、音夢の隣に
腰をおろす。
dialogues.en: I sat next to Nemu as I brought her an apple for dessert.
dialogues.text: I sat next to Nemu as I brought her an apple for dessert.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ん……そうだね。まぁ、風邪っていうより花
　粉症みたいな感じだけど」
dialogues.en: "I guess. But it feels more like an allergy than cold."
dialogues.text: "I guess. But it feels more like an allergy than cold."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「花粉症？　前も言ってたな」
dialogues.en: "An allergy? I remember you saying that."
dialogues.text: "An allergy? I remember you saying that."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。さっき窓を開けて換気してたけど、そ
　れから身体がおかしくて」
dialogues.en:
"I opened the window to let fresh air in, but I've felt
weird since then."
dialogues.text:
"I opened the window to let fresh air in, but I've felt
weird since then."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「風のせいじゃないか」
そんなことは有り得ないと知りつつ呟く。
dialogues.en: I knew it wasn't the wind, but I mumbled anyway.
dialogues.text: I knew it wasn't the wind, but I mumbled anyway.

dialogues.jp:
桜の香りは変わりはしないのだが、空気はまろ
やかになり、喉越しがよくなった。
dialogues.en:
The scent of the cherry blossom's the same, but the air's
softened and it feels mild.
dialogues.text:
The scent of the cherry blossom's the same, but the air's
softened and it feels mild.

dialogues.jp: コーヒーよりはココアのような季節。
dialogues.en: For example, it's like a hot cocoa rather than a coffee.
dialogues.text: For example, it's like a hot cocoa rather than a coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「明日は入学式なのに……」
なにげない呟きだった。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「結局、委員会の仕事もほとんどやってないし。
　美春にも迷惑かけちゃったなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"I haven't been able to attend any school committee
meetings, and I feel bad for Miharu."
dialogues.text:
"I haven't been able to attend any school committee
meetings, and I feel bad for Miharu."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「リンゴ、食べないのか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、うん。あんまり食欲ないから」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「無理にでも食えよ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……うん。ありがとう」
しゃり……と、音夢が｛ひとかけら／一欠片｝だけ口にする。
dialogues.en: Nemu had a bite of an apple.
dialogues.text: Nemu had a bite of an apple.

dialogues.jp:
だが、表情は笑顔というよりは、不味いものを
我慢して食べているようなものだ。
dialogues.en:
But she looked like she was forcing herself to eat rather
than being happy.
dialogues.text:
But she looked like she was forcing herself to eat rather
than being happy.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「美味しい」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あぅ……ごめんね。せっかく切ってくれたの
　に」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいよ。こんなの全然面倒じゃないし」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「？　兄さん大丈夫？」
音夢のひんやりとした手が額に触れる。
dialogues.en: Nemu put her cold hand on my forehead.
dialogues.text: Nemu put her cold hand on my forehead.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんが何かを面倒に思わないなんておかし
　いよ」
dialogues.en: "It's so weird that you don't complain."
dialogues.text: "It's so weird that you don't complain."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「余計なお世話だ……」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「本当に余計なお世話だよ」
目線を逸らして、音夢が呟く。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どうしたの？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、今さ……」
耳がいかれたのだろうか。

目の前の妹から、不思議な単語が漏れて聞こえ
たような……。
dialogues.en: I think Nemu said something I didn't expect......
dialogues.text: I think Nemu said something I didn't expect......

dialogues.jp: 「……なんでもない」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「なんでもないことを、そんな気になるように
　言わないでよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't say it like that, as if it's nothing. It worried me."
dialogues.text: "Don't say it like that, as if it's nothing. It worried me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ？　あぁ」

どうやら気のせいではなく、音夢の機嫌は本当
に悪いらしい。
dialogues.en: So it wasn't me, Nemu really is in a bad mood.
dialogues.text: So it wasn't me, Nemu really is in a bad mood.

dialogues.jp: それならそれで……。

俺はぼんやりとしながら、なんの放送をしてる
のかも分からないテレビを見つめた。
dialogues.en:
I spaced out staring at the television. I couldn't tell what
was going on in the program we were watching.
dialogues.text:
I spaced out staring at the television. I couldn't tell what
was going on in the program we were watching.

dialogues.jp:
さくらの言ったことが本当か知らないが、ふた
りの距離を微妙に広げている今、音夢が突然倒
れたりすることはない。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure if what Sakura said was true, but I decided to
keep some distance between us so Nemu doesn't collapse. And
she hasn't collapsed since then.
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure if what Sakura said was true, but I decided to
keep some distance between us so Nemu doesn't collapse. And
she hasn't collapsed since then.

dialogues.jp: ただ、食は日に日に細くなり。
dialogues.en: But she's losing her appetite day by day.
dialogues.text: But she's losing her appetite day by day.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ふぁ……ん」
なにより睡眠時間が増えた。
「眠いのか？」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。このテレビ見たら寝る」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. I'm going to bed after I watch this."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. I'm going to bed after I watch this."

dialogues.jp:
まるで子供が、深夜の映画を見ているような感
じだが、音夢が起きてからまだ３時間も経って
いない。
dialogues.en:
It sounded like a child trying to stay up late to watch
movie, but it hasn't even been 3 hours since she woke up.
dialogues.text:
It sounded like a child trying to stay up late to watch
movie, but it hasn't even been 3 hours since she woke up.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「本当に春眠暁を覚えずというか、なんでこん
　なに眠いんだろう……？」
dialogues.en:
"They say you get sleepy in spring, but why am I so sleepy
like this?"
dialogues.text:
"They say you get sleepy in spring, but why am I so sleepy
like this?"

dialogues.jp:
自覚というよりも、自分が１日の半分以上を寝
ている事実に、音夢も首をかしげるしかあるま
い。
dialogues.en:
Nemu wondered since she was sleeping more than half of the
day.
dialogues.text:
Nemu wondered since she was sleeping more than half of the
day.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、寝る子は育つということだ」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「私、子供じゃありません！」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「むかっ！　なによその反応！？」
生温かい瞳で音夢を見つめる。
だけど──。
そんな眼差しが本当はしたいわけじゃなくて。
dialogues.en: "You're the one who made me into a woman!"
dialogues.text: "You're the one who made me into a woman!"

dialogues.jp: 音夢が──。
愛しくて。
ぬくもりを、髪の毛の甘い匂いを感じたくて。
抱きしめたい。

空気を求めるような自然さで、俺は音夢を抱き
寄せようと手を伸ばし――。
dialogues.en:
She realized what she said, and she looked down, her face
and ears blushing.
dialogues.text:
She realized what she said, and she looked down, her face
and ears blushing.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "No, I take it back! You didn't hear it......"
dialogues.text: "No, I take it back! You didn't hear it......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんでもない」
dialogues.en: "I don't know what you're talking about."
dialogues.text: "I don't know what you're talking about."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何だよ？　その顔は」
dialogues.en: Nemu mumbled covering her cheeks with her hands.
dialogues.text: Nemu mumbled covering her cheeks with her hands.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「何でもない顔してないよ」

もう遅いとわかっていながら、慌てて顔を手で
隠す。
dialogues.en:
Because Nemu said something like that, it made me feel
weird.
dialogues.text:
Because Nemu said something like that, it made me feel
weird.

dialogues.jp: 「何でもないっ。何でもないんだよっ！」

なかば怒るように言い放ち、ソファーから立ち
上がって頭を振る。
dialogues.en: And I reached out to hold her......
dialogues.text: And I reached out to hold her......

dialogues.jp:
「……なんか俺も眠いから、部屋で昼寝してく
　る」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……お前もそのテレビが終わったら寝ろよ」

居心地の悪さに、音夢の顔を見ることなんて出
来なかった。
dialogues.en: I stood up from the sofa and shook my head.
dialogues.text: I stood up from the sofa and shook my head.

dialogues.jp: 音夢に背中を向ける。
dialogues.en:
"I'm kind of sleepy too. I'll go take a nap in my room. You
go to sleep after this show, okay?"
dialogues.text:
"I'm kind of sleepy too. I'll go take a nap in my room. You
go to sleep after this show, okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おやすみ、兄さん」

部屋を出る時、音夢がそう言ったような気がし
た。

dialogues.en:
I covered my mouth feeling embarrassed and walked out of the
room.
dialogues.text:
I covered my mouth feeling embarrassed and walked out of the
room.

dialogues.jp: 壁によりかかってため息をつく。
「何やってるんだよ、俺は……」
dialogues.en: I leaned against the wall and sighed.
dialogues.text: I leaned against the wall and sighed.

dialogues.jp: 音夢のそばにいると言ったのに。
dialogues.en: I can't get close to Nemu.
dialogues.text: I can't get close to Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 音夢に近づいてはいけなくて。
dialogues.en: Can I manage to do this?
dialogues.text: Can I manage to do this?

dialogues.jp: そんなことが｛も／保｝つのだろうか？
「……１週間ですらこれだ」
音夢を抱きしめたい。
dialogues.en: I don't want to let her go.
dialogues.text: I don't want to let her go.

dialogues.jp: ずっと離したくない。
dialogues.en: I want to love her with all my heart.
dialogues.text: I want to love her with all my heart.

dialogues.jp: 俺の愛情を全て注いでやりたい。
それなのに――。

dialogues.en: I shook my head making a fist.
dialogues.text: I shook my head making a fist.

dialogues.jp: 拳を握り締めて首をふる。
胸が痛い。
ジクジクと痛む。
dialogues.en: Is this my pain, or her pain?
dialogues.text: Is this my pain, or her pain?

dialogues.jp: この痛みは俺のものか、音夢のものか……。
dialogues.en:
I felt she was looking this way on the other side of the
wall.
dialogues.text:
I felt she was looking this way on the other side of the
wall.

dialogues.jp:
壁越しに、音夢がこちらを見ていることが分か
る。
dialogues.en: We knew what each other's thinking telepathically.
dialogues.text: We knew what each other's thinking telepathically.

dialogues.jp: ふたりの想いを伝える力。
行かないで。
dialogues.en: I want you to kiss me good night.
dialogues.text: I want you to kiss me good night.

dialogues.jp: おやすみのキスをして欲しい。
dialogues.en: I want you to hold me.
dialogues.text: I want you to hold me.

dialogues.jp: 抱きしめて欲しい。
dialogues.en: I want you to embrace me with your body.
dialogues.text: I want you to embrace me with your body.

dialogues.jp: その大きな身体で包み込んで欲しい。
dialogues.en: It hurts me to see you sad like that.
dialogues.text: It hurts me to see you sad like that.

dialogues.jp:
そして、兄さんの悲しそうな目を見るのが、一
番辛い……。
dialogues.en:
The feelings came up, but I couldn't tell if it was my
delusion or not.
dialogues.text:
The feelings came up, but I couldn't tell if it was my
delusion or not.

dialogues.jp: 自分の妄想との区別もつかない感情が浮かぶ。
「こんなもの……」
胸が痛い。
dialogues.en: It's aching for two of us.
dialogues.text: It's aching for two of us.

dialogues.jp: ふたり分の心の痛さ。
dialogues.en: Even if...... it was a happy feeling.
dialogues.text: Even if...... it was a happy feeling.

dialogues.jp:
たとえば――これが喜びの感情であったとして
も。
dialogues.en:
The excitement of the first kiss and when we made love makes
her heart race crazy like that.
dialogues.text:
The excitement of the first kiss and when we made love makes
her heart race crazy like that.

dialogues.jp:
初めてキスをしたときや、抱きしめ合っている
時の感情の高ぶりが、あの異常な｛どうき／動悸｝を生み出
すことになるのだ。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure no one would be able to take that, just as Sakura
said.
dialogues.text:
I'm sure no one would be able to take that, just as Sakura
said.

dialogues.jp:
さくらが言うように、こんなものに人間が耐え
られるとは思えない。
「かったりぃ」
dialogues.en:
I spat the words out, and went upstairs feeling like I'm the
one who's sick.
dialogues.text:
I spat the words out, and went upstairs feeling like I'm the
one who's sick.

dialogues.jp: ◆穏やかな春の日◆

音夢の体調が思わしくない中、入学式が迫って
いた。
dialogues.en:
The first day of school is tomorrow, but Nemu's still not
feeling well.
dialogues.text:
The first day of school is tomorrow, but Nemu's still not
feeling well.

dialogues.jp:
居間でくつろぐふたりだが、俺は極力音夢を避
けようと努力する。
dialogues.en:
We hang out in the living room, but I try to avoid Nemu as
much as I can.
dialogues.text:
We hang out in the living room, but I try to avoid Nemu as
much as I can.

dialogues.jp:
どうにかキスのひとつもせずに離れて……。音
夢のそばにいられない。
dialogues.en:
I made it through without kissing her, but I didn't realize
it hurts me so much not being able to love her the way I
want to.
dialogues.text:
I made it through without kissing her, but I didn't realize
it hurts me so much not being able to love her the way I
want to.

dialogues.jp:
ただそれだけのことが、こんなにも辛いことだ
とは思わなかった。
